tools.name: search_public_tenders
tools.description:
Search public-sector tenders in TED (EU official procurement notices).
`country` is an ISO-3166 alpha-3 buyer-country code (e.g. 'ESP'), or
'ALL' for EU-wide. `keyword` full-text searches notice content.
`cpv_prefix` filters by CPV classification code prefix (e.g. '45' for
construction). `days_back`
